purpose: HARMONICODE full developer IDE and external-LLM-agent harness; native optimization must preserve conventional interfaces and must not export internal frame or admission restrictions as artificial application restrictions.

boundaries.name: frontend_ide
preserve: debugger terminal Git build test deploy integration
external agent sessions and tool invocation
boundaries.native_scope: native proof and computational capabilities are invoked via services, never a requirement for UI rendering
prohibit: frame width used as UI source length ceiling
native token layout imposed as conventional editor schema

boundaries.name: ingress
boundaries.native_scope: native frames and candidate verification are internal ingress implementation
prohibit: whole-file size cap derived from 648-byte frame
modality rejection without an actual underlying capability or contract

boundaries.name: egress
boundaries.native_scope: native result projection through existing encoder/decoder
prohibit: forcing raw Hash216 or VM81 encoding as sole output type
dropping order, provenance or leading zeros

boundaries.name: native_vm81
preserve: single signed canonical admission and replay
boundaries.native_scope: only canonical runtime can mutate native authoritative state

boundaries.name: lane5
preserve: all inherited Lane 1–4 virtual CPU architectures
native optimization and integrated Ubuntu capabilities
boundaries.native_scope: candidate-only native optimization until signed VM81 admission
prohibit: replacing inherited hardware with a narrow surrogate
assuming guest operating-system limits define native capability ceiling

validation.rule: check source index presence and rule markers, plus inspect any proposed new restrictions separately before merging
